pages.title: Godel Sentence
pages.text: A statement that says, of itself, that it cannot be proven. If the system could prove it, it would be false; so it is true, and unprovable. Godel showed every system rich enough for arithmetic contains one. The crystal reads differently each time and is always right.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Cantor Diagonalizer, a Superintelligence Core encoded a Formal Proof Tree into numbers using a Riemann Zeta Crystal. The diagonal of that encoding produced a sentence the core could not prove, and knew was true.
